title: Persona Activations Management
summary: This module processes model rollouts to extract and aggregate residual stream activations, quantifying the influence of specific personas. It provides tools for analyzing how personas manifest internally within the language model.

nodes.label: Model Rollout Data
nodes.title: Model Rollout Data
nodes.description: Structured input containing system prompts, questions, and assistant responses from various model interactions, used to derive persona activations.

nodes.label: LLM Inference Engine
nodes.title: LLM Inference Engine
nodes.description: The core components of the language model (model, tokenizer, device) required to perform forward passes and extract internal activations.

nodes.label: Compute Residual Activations
nodes.title: Compute Residual Activations
nodes.description: An external utility that processes model outputs to calculate the mean residual stream activations for specific assistant turns, crucial for persona analysis.

nodes.label: Calculate Persona Activations
nodes.title: Calculate Persona Activations
nodes.description: Iterates through model rollouts, extracting and aggregating residual stream activations to quantify the influence of a specific persona.

nodes.label: Persona Activation Vectors
nodes.title: Persona Activation Vectors
nodes.description: The resulting mean and stacked PyTorch tensors representing the aggregated activation patterns associated with a persona across multiple model interactions.

groups.label: Activation Processing
groups.title: Persona Activation Processing
groups.description: Encapsulates the core logic for iterating through model rollouts and orchestrating the extraction and aggregation of persona-specific activation vectors.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Activation Data Flow
groups.description: Manages the input data representing model interactions and the output data comprising the computed persona activation vectors.
